description:
List webhook egress addresses

Returns the public network addresses from which this environment sends webhook deliveries. Use this information when configuring the receiving system's network allowlist. The result is environment-specific and does not describe the API service's ingress addresses.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/webhook-delivery/list-webhook-egress-addresses
name: listWebhookEgressAddresses

ipAddresses.description: Every public IPv4 address webhook deliveries can originate from. Allow-list all of them; deliveries are spread across every address.

title: List webhook egress addresses
